verification.source: Full release gate on Linux builder containers, with Rust gate on the same builder; no GitHub Actions
steps: Go root/executor/conformance race/vet, Rust fmt/clippy/tests and three DSM targets passed
Python mypy/22 tests including Python 3.8 and Node 31 tests including Node 18 passed
463 TypeScript tests against UI 0.12.0; typecheck/build/pack and packed consumer import passed
Three-architecture Linux vet/build and cold-cache executor/lifecycle reproducibility passed
arm64 and armv7 taskscript binaries passed under qemu user emulation; not NAS/kernel certification
Versioned Go modules fetched through remote tags into separate clean GOMODCACHE directories identify the release source
npmjs exact versions/latest and downloaded SDK/App tarballs equal gated archives
verification.approvalImpact: All six executor/lifecycle digests match 0.15.1. Upgrading from 0.15.1 adds no administrator reapproval requirement; upgrades from 0.15.0 retain the one-time approval introduced in 0.15.1.
verification.comparisonWith0.15.1: All three executor and all three lifecycle digests are unchanged (go1.26.9).
